data.summary: Open Cairn coordinator panel (title 'cairn coordinator'). The landing page centers on an 'Enroll a host' flow: the operator mints a single-use token in the operator console at /admin/dashboard (linked as primary CTA 'Open operator console', likely auth-gated), then the target host runs 'curl -fsSL <coord>/enroll/install?token=<TOKEN> | sudo bash'. The install endpoint is /enroll/install?token=<TOKEN>; page inline script builds the URL from location.origin. This is a swarm host-enrollment / C2 onboarding flow. Page scripts disclose /api/v1/version (returns JSON schema {version, commit, date, tls, format, repo schema v1}) and /status.json (polled client-side for counters). Footer self-describes the binary: 'cairn coordinator, pkg:go, single-binary, distroless'. Inline script carries CSP nonce. Grade of flow: OBSERVED (page states it). Use against real targets: NOT observed. No credentials seen. No sessions started.

data.summary: All 352 graded profiles are UNDETERMINED; the review gate is closed on this evidence. Reason classes: 247 open dashboards are SPA shells whose project/target content loads client-side via API, so no targets, tasking, operator notes, or attack objectives are observable from static HTML; ~28 static scrapes inconclusive (error pages or JS-required); ~20 auth-walled panels (login form present, no bypass attempted). Nothing in the visible chrome indicates active malicious use or confirms a benign demo. Counsel's standing: the evidence cannot support a better verdict; a new pass over the same HTML will not change the answer. Moving verdicts requires API-level data (the /api/v1/version, /status.json, /projects family endpoints the pages disclose) or authorized interaction, both out of scope for this pass.
data.title: Counsel review of 352 panel profiles: all UNDETERMINED, gate closed (2026-10-19)
